items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses regarding the construction of tabernacle furnishings

items.quote: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal
items.claim: Moses is commanded to make a brass laver with brass base for washing

items.quote: thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar
items.claim: The laver is commanded to be positioned between the tabernacle and altar
items.place: between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar

items.claim: Water is commanded to be placed in the laver
